subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup/restore config surface once the safety blockers and proof gap are fixed, or should the work pause in favor of the broader backup design issue?
rationale: The PR adds new core CLI commands, config keys, encrypted credential/state backup behavior, and destructive restore behavior, so correctness findings alone cannot settle whether this is the intended core product surface.

options.title: Keep as a core candidate after fixes
options.body: Require the contributor or a maintainer to fix the security blockers, rebase, and supply redacted real behavior proof before another merge review.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that preserves local archive/export improvements while deferring folder-backed snapshots and restore policy.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Close or pause this branch and route backup scheduling, off-machine storage, and per-agent restore through the broader open backup issues.

recommendation.title: Keep as a core candidate after fixes
recommendation.body: Require the contributor or a maintainer to fix the security blockers, rebase, and supply redacted real behavior proof before another merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original backup CLI PR and are the best available history-backed owner for deciding whether this follow-up belongs in core.
